overview.about: The United States Grand Prix has moved around the country for decades but found a lasting home in 2012 at the Circuit of the Americas in Austin, Texas. COTA's steep uphill first corner, fast esses and modern layout have made it a fan favourite, and F1's American boom has turned the race weekend into a festival. Lewis Hamilton has won the US Grand Prix six times across two venues. The 2026 race is on 23-25 October.
overview.nextEvent: The 2026 United States Grand Prix runs 23-25 October at the Circuit of the Americas in Austin. It is one of three US races on the modern calendar alongside Miami and Las Vegas, reflecting Formula 1's rapid growth in America.

@graph.description: The United States Grand Prix is Formula 1’s Austin race at Circuit of the Americas. The World Championship first held a United States Grand Prix in 1959, while the Austin circuit has hosted the event since 2012. Its design includes fast changes of direction and a steep climb into the opening corner, giving the race a permanent-circuit character distinct from Formula 1’s street events. The existing OneSliders page supplies the edition dates in Event JSON-LD, and this record keeps those stated dates rather than estimating a calendar change. A Formula 1 weekend centres on practice, qualifying and the Grand Prix; official event information governs session timing, grandstand entry and venue access for each edition.
